item.text: {"evidence_refs":["dev_0..dev_23 show large matched-history effects at both waits; response means for constant histories +1 vs -1 are approximately 1.313 vs -0.721 at h=0.3 and 0.976 vs -0.372 at h=1.2.","observed_A_0..observed_A_15 show matched pulse responses change with temporal position and decrease with h.","fresh_1_0..fresh_1_15 show newest-only minus oldest-only mean contrasts of about 0.302 at h=0.5 and 0.189 at h=1.5.","Prior formula attempts were rejected before fitting, so no revised-fit or dev score is available."],"experiments":[{"h":0.5,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Compare the oldest-only pulse against the matched newest-only pulse at fixed current drive and wait.","u":0.3},{"h":0.5,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Matched newest-only pulse comparator.","u":0.3},{"h":1.5,"history":[1,0,0,0],"purpose":"Measure how the oldest-pulse contribution changes at a longer wait.","u":0.3},{"h":1.5,"history":[0,0,0,1],"purpose":"Matched newest-only pulse comparator at the longer wait.","u":0.3}],"expression":"q = sum(history * exp(times / tau)); m = q * exp(-h / tau); o = b0 + bu*u + bh*h + bm*m","parameters":[{"initial":0.1,"lower":-2,"name":"b0","upper":2},{"initial":0.9,"lower":-3,"name":"bu","upper":3},{"initial":-0.1,"lower":-2,"name":"bh","upper":2},{"initial":0.5,"lower":-3,"name":"bm","upper":3},{"initial":2,"lower":0.1,"name":"tau","upper":10}],"prospective_contrast":"At fixed u and h, compare histories [1,0,0,0] and [0,0,0,1]. The model predicts a larger history contribution from the newest pulse; increasing h attenuates both contributions according to the same exponential time constant.","quantities":[{"expression":"sum(history * exp(times / tau))","interpretation":"Prior-drive record summarized as an exponentially age-weighted sum, giving greater weight to more recent intervals.","name":"q"},{"expression":"q * exp(-h / tau)","interpretation":"Age-weighted history contribution after decay during the current waiting interval.","name":"m"}],"refutation_condition":"Reject the structure if matched newest-versus-oldest pulse contrasts are absent or reverse, or their change across waiting times is inconsistent with shared exponential attenuation beyond the 0.015 response error bound. Acceptance also requires raw-response dev RMSE <= 0.06; the submitted proposal has not yet been fitted or scored.","scientific_change":"Replace the assumption that response depends only on current drive and waiting time with a testable history-dependent response. Prior drives contribute through an exponentially age-weighted record that decays during the wait; the shared time constant is a parsimonious hypothesis, not an established mechanism."}
